decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent perfect binder in a growing finishing market, it likely remains worth keeping as a relatively low-cost option, though overlap with stronger automation-oriented offers raises some rationalization risk.

The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated push toward automation and lifecycle service, so with uncertainty not clearly resolved and carrying costs likely modest for this wholesaler, management would tend to retain it.
This booklet maker is close to the established portfolio and supports digital print finishing, so the firm is likely to keep the option open unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.
